entities.name: Hammerheim
entities.description: A mountain fortress at a crossroads in the Domains of Dominaria, controlling trade to Cape Tempest, in North Aerona.

entities.name: Domains of Dominaria
entities.description: A region of Dominaria containing Hammerheim.

entities.name: Cape Tempest
entities.description: A place to which trade flows through Hammerheim.

entities.name: Hammerheim Order
entities.description: A group of pyromancers from Hammerheim during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: A war during which the Hammerheim Order existed.

relations.note: Hammerheim is in North Aerona between the Smoke Mountains and the Sea of Whales.
relations.quote: It is located in North Aerona , between the Smoke Mountains and the Sea of Whales .

relations.note: The Hammerheim Order was a group of pyromancers from Hammerheim.
relations.quote: The Hammerheim Order was a group of pyromancers from Hammerheim during the Brothers' War .
Hammerheim is the birthplace of Bartel Runeaxe .
